package ai

import (
	
	"crypto/sha256"
 "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/identity"
 flruntime "github.com/floegence/floret/v7/runtime"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/floegence/redeven/internal/config"
	"github.com/floegence/redeven/internal/session"
	"github.com/floegence/redeven/internal/threadreadstate"
)

// This producer is compiled with the unmodified 10ce4c152 production tree.
func TestGenerateFlowerUpgradeBaseline(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("FLOWER_BASELINE_OUTPUT")
	if dir == "" { t.Skip("explicit historical fixture generation only") }
	var calls, approvals, spawns, crashes atomic.Int32
 marker := os.Getenv("FLOWER_BASELINE_MARKER")
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var req map[string]any
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil { t.Error(err); return }
		flusher := w.(http.Flusher)
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		model, _ := req["model"].(string)
		tools, _ := req["tools"].([]any)
		encoded,_:=json.Marshal(req["input"])
        if len(tools)>0 && strings.Contains(string(encoded),"fixture-approval-input") && approvals.Add(1)==1 {
            writeDeepSeekIntegrationToolCall(w,flusher,"fixture_approval","fixture_approval_call","terminal.exec",`{"command":"printf synthetic_approval","yield_ms":1000}`);return
        }
        if len(tools)>0 && strings.Contains(string(encoded),"fixture-parent-delegation") && spawns.Add(1)==1 {
            writeDeepSeekIntegrationToolCall(w,flusher,"fixture_spawn","fixture_spawn_call","subagents",`{"action":"spawn","task_name":"Synthetic child","task_description":"Preserve child identity","message":"Return a synthetic child completion.","agent_type":"explore","context_mode":"mission_only"}`);return
        }
        if len(tools)>0 && strings.Contains(string(encoded),"fixture-crash-tool") && crashes.Add(1)==1 {
            args,_:=json.Marshal(map[string]any{"command":"printf committed > '"+marker+"'; sleep 120","yield_ms":1000})
            writeDeepSeekIntegrationToolCall(w,flusher,"fixture_crash","fixture_crash_call","terminal.exec",string(args));return
        }
        if len(tools)>0 && strings.Contains(string(encoded),"fixture-wait-input") {
            args:=`{"reason_code":"missing_external_input","required_from_user":["Choose a target."],"evidence_refs":[],"questions":[{"id":"target","header":"Target","question":"Which target?","response_mode":"write","is_secret":false}]}`
            writeDeepSeekIntegrationToolCall(w,flusher,"fixture_wait","fixture_wait_call","ask_user",args)
            return
        }
        if len(tools) > 0 && calls.Add(1) == 1 {
			writeDeepSeekIntegrationToolCall(w, flusher, "fixture_tool", "fixture_tool_call", "retired_fixture_tool", `{"input":"synthetic baseline"}`)
			return
		}
		writeDeepSeekIntegrationTextResponseForModel(w, flusher, "fixture_response", model, "Synthetic baseline response.")
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	svc, err := NewService(Options{Logger:slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard,nil)), StateDir:dir, AgentHomeDir:dir, Shell:"/bin/sh",
		Config:&config.AIConfig{CurrentModelID:"deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash", Providers:[]config.AIProvider{{ID:"deepseek",Type:"deepseek",BaseURL:server.URL+"/v1",Models:[]config.AIProviderModel{{ModelName:"deepseek-v4-flash"},{ModelName:"deepseek-v4-pro"}}}}},
		RunMaxWallTime:20*time.Second, RunIdleTimeout:10*time.Second, ResolveProviderAPIKey:func(string)(string,bool,error){return "synthetic-test-key",true,nil},
	})
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	defer svc.Close()
	meta := &session.Meta{EndpointID:"fixture_endpoint",NamespacePublicID:"fixture_namespace",UserPublicID:"fixture_user",ChannelID:"fixture_channel",CanRead:true,CanWrite:true,CanExecute:true,CanAdmin:true}
	thread, err := svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Baseline conversation","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionFullAccess,"")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	owner, err := NewUploadOwner(meta.EndpointID,meta.UserPublicID,meta.ChannelID)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	scope, err := svc.CreateUploadStagingScope(t.Context(),owner,thread.ThreadID)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	content, name := "Synthetic attachment retained across upgrades.\n", "baseline.txt"
	upload, err := svc.SaveUpload(t.Context(),SaveUploadRequest{Owner:owner,StagingScopeID:scope.StagingScopeID,StagingCapability:scope.Capability,Reader:strings.NewReader(content),DisplayName:name,UploadRequestID:"fixture-upload",ExpectedContentSHA256:fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256([]byte(content))),ExpectedSizeBytes:int64(len(content)),DisplayNameSHA256:fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256([]byte(name)))})
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	_, err = svc.SendUserTurn(t.Context(),meta,SendUserTurnRequest{ClientRequestID:"fixture-turn-1",ThreadID:thread.ThreadID,StagingScopeID:scope.StagingScopeID,StagingCapability:scope.Capability,Model:thread.ModelID,Input:RunInput{Text:"Keep this synthetic conversation and attachment.",Attachments:[]RunAttachmentIn{{AttachmentID:upload.AttachmentID}}},Options:RunOptions{PermissionType:config.AIPermissionFullAccess}})
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	waitForAskUserIntegrationThread(t,svc,meta,thread.ThreadID,func(view *ThreadView)bool{return view.RunStatus=="success"})
	if err = svc.SetThreadModel(t.Context(),meta,thread.ThreadID,"deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro"); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	sendAndWaitForModelSwitch(t,svc,meta,thread.ThreadID,"A turn after a model switch.","deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro")
	attachmentFork, err := svc.ForkThread(t.Context(),meta,thread.ThreadID,"Attachment fork regression")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	plain, err := svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Plain conversation","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionFullAccess,"")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	sendAndWaitForModelSwitch(t,svc,meta,plain.ThreadID,"Plain conversation before fork.","")
	fork, err := svc.ForkThread(t.Context(),meta,plain.ThreadID,"Baseline fork")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	sendAndWaitForModelSwitch(t,svc,meta,fork.ThreadID,"Continue the fork.","")
	nested, err := svc.ForkThread(t.Context(),meta,fork.ThreadID,"Baseline nested fork")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	sendAndWaitForModelSwitch(t,svc,meta,nested.ThreadID,"Continue the nested fork.","")
    approval,err:=svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Waiting approval","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionApprovalRequired,"")
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    if _,err=svc.SendUserTurn(t.Context(),meta,SendUserTurnRequest{ClientRequestID:"fixture-approval",ThreadID:approval.ThreadID,Input:RunInput{Text:"fixture-approval-input"}});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    deadline:=time.Now().Add(10*time.Second)
    for { v,e:=svc.threadRuntime.View(t.Context(),identity.ThreadID(approval.ThreadID));if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};if len(v.Interactions)>0 && v.Interactions[0].Kind==flruntime.ThreadInteractionApproval{break};if time.Now().After(deadline){t.Fatalf("approval timeout: %+v",v)};time.Sleep(10*time.Millisecond) }
    parent,err:=svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Parent with child","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionFullAccess,"")
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    sendAndWaitForModelSwitch(t,svc,meta,parent.ThreadID,"fixture-parent-delegation","")
    parentID:=identity.ThreadID(parent.ThreadID)
    children,err:=svc.threadRuntime.List(t.Context(),flruntime.ThreadScope{ParentID:&parentID})
    if err!=nil||len(children)!=1{t.Fatalf("children=%+v %v",children,err)}
    deadline=time.Now().Add(10*time.Second)
    for { v,e:=svc.threadRuntime.View(t.Context(),children[0].ID);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};if v.Activity==flruntime.ThreadActivityIdle && v.LastOutcome!=nil{break};if time.Now().After(deadline){t.Fatalf("child timeout: %+v",v)};time.Sleep(10*time.Millisecond) }
    cancelled,err:=svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Cancelled input","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionFullAccess,"")
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    if _,err=svc.SendUserTurn(t.Context(),meta,SendUserTurnRequest{ClientRequestID:"fixture-cancel",ThreadID:cancelled.ThreadID,Input:RunInput{Text:"fixture-wait-input"}});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    waitForAskUserIntegrationThread(t,svc,meta,cancelled.ThreadID,func(v *ThreadView)bool{return v.WaitingPrompt!=nil})
    if _,err=svc.StopThread(t.Context(),meta,cancelled.ThreadID);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
	waiting,err:=svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Waiting conversation","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionFullAccess,"")
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    if _,err=svc.SendUserTurn(t.Context(),meta,SendUserTurnRequest{ClientRequestID:"fixture-wait",ThreadID:waiting.ThreadID,Input:RunInput{Text:"fixture-wait-input"}});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    waitForAskUserIntegrationThread(t,svc,meta,waiting.ThreadID,func(view *ThreadView)bool{return view.WaitingPrompt!=nil})
    queued,err:=svc.SendUserTurn(t.Context(),meta,SendUserTurnRequest{ClientRequestID:"fixture-queued",ThreadID:waiting.ThreadID,Input:RunInput{Text:"Input queued while waiting for a response."}})
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    if queued.Kind!="queued"{t.Fatalf("queued kind=%s",queued.Kind)}
	readPath := filepath.Join(dir,"apps","appserver","thread_read_state.sqlite")
	reads, err := threadreadstate.Open(readPath)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if _,err = reads.EnsureFlower(t.Context(),meta.EndpointID,meta.UserPublicID,map[string]threadreadstate.FlowerSnapshot{thread.ThreadID:{ActivityRevision:1}}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err = reads.Close(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	crashed,err:=svc.CreateThread(t.Context(),meta,"Uncertain tool at process exit","deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",config.AIPermissionFullAccess,"")
    if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    if _,err=svc.SendUserTurn(t.Context(),meta,SendUserTurnRequest{ClientRequestID:"fixture-crash",ThreadID:crashed.ThreadID,Input:RunInput{Text:"fixture-crash-tool"}});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
    deadline=time.Now().Add(10*time.Second)
    for { if _,err:=os.Stat(marker);err==nil{break};if time.Now().After(deadline){t.Fatal("tool did not execute")};time.Sleep(10*time.Millisecond) }

	manifest := map[string]any{"redeven_commit":"10ce4c15212c7f4b6d2a449507b9e47d6bc31d1a","floret_version":"v7.5.0","endpoint_id":meta.EndpointID,"user_public_id":meta.UserPublicID,"thread_ids":[]string{thread.ThreadID,plain.ThreadID,fork.ThreadID,nested.ThreadID},"attachment_id":upload.AttachmentID,"attachment_fork_id":attachmentFork.ThreadID,"waiting_thread_id":waiting.ThreadID,"approval_thread_id":approval.ThreadID,"parent_thread_id":parent.ThreadID,"child_thread_id":string(children[0].ID),"cancelled_thread_id":cancelled.ThreadID,"crashed_thread_id":crashed.ThreadID,"scenarios":[]string{"conversation","attachment","tool_call_and_result","model_switch","fork","nested_fork","read_state","waiting_input","queue","waiting_approval","subagent","cancelled","uncertain_tool","process_exit_with_wal"}}
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest,"","  ")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,"writer.json"),raw,0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 os.Exit(91)
}
